profile.headline: Software Engineer | Prev AWS, Everpure | SF + NYC

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Big Lynx’s CREdna is a real estate intelligence platform that aggregates data and provides quantitative signals to help guide investment decisions. My team owns the data pipeline and backend service responsible for ingesting external data, calculating and normalizing property-level signals, and making them available through APIs. 

I build new signals end to end using Python, FastAPI, and Postgres, with a focus on reusable integrations and reliable data processing.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · FastAPI · PostgreSQL · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Pure Storage’s FlashArray is an enterprise block storage platform and ActiveCluster is its active-active synchronous data replication feature for high availability and disaster recovery. My team owned the backend control-plane and orchestration logic for replication and snapshot management. 

I owned multiple projects from design to testing and rollout, primarily implementing features in C++ and corresponding API changes in Java. I also participated in on-call and triage rotations, debugging failures in a distributed storage system.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Java · REST APIs · Distributed Systems · Replication (Computing) · pytest

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
RDS PostgreSQL is one of AWS’s managed relational database offerings. I worked on the control plane team, responsible for the infrastructure used to provision, configure, and manage database instances. 

I designed and executed Java integration tests and end-to-end validation for the launch of dual-stack/IPv6 networking support. I also scoped and delivered a migration of the team’s CI/CD pipeline from using long lived to temporary security credentials, reducing reliance on persistent secrets.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Distributed Systems · Cloud Infrastructure · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Director Of Partnerships
positions.description:
Bit Project is a 501(c)(3) organization created with the mission of making tech education more accessible through free open source programming courses. As part of the three-person core team, my main role was building and maintaining relationships with corporate sponsors and industry professionals. 

I also proposed and led an outreach initiative to expand our programs among communities underrepresented in tech, developing partnerships with a veterans organization and multiple HBCUs. This effort helped broaden our recruitment and increase the diversity of our student population.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: I worked on the Electronic Trading team. My project involved using NLP and scikit-learn to classify client requests and predict future ones, with the goal of reducing the sales team’s workload. I also built a UI component using Python/Flask to create an API and dashboard.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Flask · AngularJS · Scikit-Learn

positions.title: Data Analytics Intern
positions.description:
- Interacted with business team to produce reports using Power BI to meet their needs
- Converted raw data into fact and dimension tables to more easily use them in reports
- Analyzed data to create visuals to help internal audit team monitor employees’ travel expenses
- Built and executed complex/nested SQL queries to calculate market share and growth given tables of various companies’ revenues for the past five years with millions of rows of data
- Created dashboards with above data to assist business team in analyzing competition through interactive visuals enabling them to filter based on products, year, quarter, location

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
- Taught kids aged 7-12 robotics, primarily using LEGO MINDSTORMS EV3 sets
- Employed unique teaching styles to keep kids engaged and to make sure they gained a solid foundation to build upon in the future
